title: They Shall Not Grow Old – New Trailer – Now Playing In Theaters
summary: The trailer for Peter Jackson's They Shall Not Grow Old, a WWI documentary built from restored, colorized archival footage and BBC interviews with British soldiers.
why: HN points to it as a way to see WWI footage restored so the war feels modern and real.

quote.text: It's really incredible and makes the war (which was only 100 years ago) feel much more modern than old black and white footage.
